story.challenge: No online presence at all, and inventory that had to stay in sync across a physical store and a new digital one.
story.solution: A Shopify build with a custom theme and inventory management wired into the in-store POS.
story.impact: 100+ sales and $12K revenue in the first month, 76 products online, customer reach up 300%.

testimonial.text: The e-commerce platform Elan built for us is incredible. Our sales tripled in the first quarter. The inventory management system makes running our business so much easier.
testimonial.author: Management Team
